post.description: At most two short follow-up questions before weaving (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md §D).

weave_instruction.title: Weave Instruction
weave_instruction.description: Author's optional free-text guidance for the weaver (e.g. 'focus on Shelly').

woven.title: Woven
woven.description: True once a weave has finished for this session; Capture then starts a fresh notebook page.

ClarifyResult.title: ClarifyResult
ClarifyResult.description: The 'understand' step: what each photo shows, what each voice note says, and ≤N questions for what can't be seen.

label.title: Label
label.description: What is visibly there, in plain words (e.g. "churros", "person").

box.title: Box
box.description: Normalized [x0, y0, x1, y1] within the photo.

cross_modal.title: Cross Modal
cross_modal.description: True when text queries and images share one embedding space (SigLIP 2).

query.title: Query
query.description: Short visual description used for embedding retrieval.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: First role is always the Anchor.

shown_as_text.title: Shown As Text
shown_as_text.description: True for "Turn into words"; False = understood quietly, stays as your voice on the page.

replacement.title: Replacement
replacement.description: "old → new" when the one allowed replacement was applied.

day.title: Day
day.description: The day most photos were taken on; the memory is filed under it.
